title: Project 1 · CLI To-Do Application
summary: A command-line to-do manager with file persistence, argument parsing and honest error handling.
requirements: Parse subcommands: add <text>, list, done <id>, rm <id>
Persist tasks to todos.json in a data dir you choose deterministically
Return non-zero exit codes with clear messages on failure
Unit-test the core operations (add/done/rm) without touching disk

milestones.title: Arg parsing skeleton
milestones.detail: Match std::env::args into an enum Command; unknown → usage message.

milestones.title: In-memory model + tests
milestones.detail: Vec<Task> CRUD functions returning Result; cover every branch.

milestones.title: JSON persistence
milestones.detail: Load/save via serde; corrupt file → friendly error, not panic.

milestones.title: Polish loop
milestones.detail: cargo clippy silent, cargo fmt applied, README with examples.

starterFiles.name: main.rs

hints: Model Task { id: u32, title: String, done: bool } and derive Serialize/Deserialize.
IDs can be max(existing)+1 computed at load time.
Keep IO in main.rs only so tests stay pure.
completionCriteria: cargo test passes with ≥ 6 unit tests
Bad input exits code 2 with usage text
